 Catley, Hinds and Foord all start for Arsenal against Spurs
 Arsenal Women 
 Tim Stillman 
 October 24, 2026 
 7 
 Steph Catley, Taylor Hinds and Caitlin Foord all start for Arsenal in the North London derby on Saturday lunchtime at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Ona Batlle, Stina Blackstenius and Lotte Wubben-Moy all drop to the bench.
 Misa starts in goal with a back four of Fox, Williamson, Catley and Hinds. Stanway and Cooney-Cross play in the midfield double pivot. Caitlin Foord and Lisa Baum start on the wings, it looks as though Russo will play as a 10 behind Olivia Smith upfront.
 16.Misa; 2.Fox, 6.Williamson(c), 7.Catley, 24.Hinds; 4.Stanway, 32.Cooney-Cross; 19.Baum, 23.Russo, 19.Foord; 11.Smith
 Subs: 1.van Domselaar, 3.Wubben-Moy, 5.De Almeida, 14.Reuteler, 22.O.Batlle, 25.Blackstenius, 28.Borbe, 31.Holmberg
